title: Battle of Waterberg
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Waterberg", at revision 1374107433, opens: "The Battle of Waterberg took place on August 11, 1904, at the Waterberg, German South West Africa, and was the decisive battle in the Herero uprising." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q178842, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1904 decisive battle in the German campaign against the Herero". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
